node.statement: The coherence contract has the logical form: given two already established data (delta_j,S_j,u_j,h_j) for which the explicitly typed Pi_{delta_j} maps are bijective with inverses (u_j,h_j), their inverses agree on the target overlap. The retraction external supplies this antecedent for (delta,S_delta,u_pol,h_pol), whereas 1.7.7.1 records that the group-laws external supplies neither S_grp nor h_grp nor bijectivity/inverse identities for a datum containing u_grp. Equality of delta and the formal expression for Pi_delta can identify the images only after that missing datum has been established; it cannot establish the datum itself. Thus the proposed coherence instantiation is invalid and u_grp=u_pol remains unproved.
